notes.title: DevLog 01 – Thank You + Welcome to Floor 32
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you to everyone who’s taken an interest in [i]Zangyou – Backrooms[/i].
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664154/cf975557598d0d2cd11970e11d220ef899fe9018.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re a very small, brand new studio based in Tokyo with a deep love for crafting moody, atmospheric experiences through games. 

This is our first project, and seeing even a few of you checking out the trailer, wishlisting, or joining our Discord means the world to us.
[/p][p][i]Zangyou[/i] begins in a quiet, empty office tower — but it’s just the beginning. We’re excited to share more devlogs and feature updates as the game continues to evolve.
[/p][p]We hope you’ll stick around and get lost with us inside Shibuya’s Floor 32.[/p][p][/p]
